## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      7 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 14 mars 2026 - 2 oct. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _mattallsop_, 17 août 2026, 1/5: "I have reported the issue to my bank. This app should be reviewed by Apple for breach of app store rules on billing."
            2. ___Mari__, 19 juil. 2026, 1/5: "Around two weeks ago, the synchronization with Google Calendar stopped working for all my reservations . I see the confirmation pop-up, but no event is added to my Google Calendar. In addition, I can no longer see any of my friends in upcoming reservations, when they have booked the same reservation. These issues are extremely frustrating and cause a great deal of inconvenience. I already contacted support, but it was not helpful. It seems that even after requesting to speak with a human, an AI bot continues the conversation instead. That’s very disappointing."
            3. _Donotwasteyourtime84_, 30 sept. 2026, 2/5: "Disappointing free trial experience. My trial was supposed to run through September 30th, but on the 30th itself my credits were already gone when I went to book a class. Earlier, the app glitched while I was trying to book a last minute class and support's only advice was to reinstall the app, which wasn't the issue and just wasted more of my time. I ended up canceling. The idea is great, but the app reliability, support, and unclear trial cutoff made it not worth continuing."
<!--/ir-theme-->
